verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no job-performance monitoring, no data-quality validation, and no failure alerting for ScrapingBee. The Usage API reports account-level credit and concurrency usage, and the CLI offers cron schedules. Both are adjacent features, not monitoring, validation, or alerts on failed jobs, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can monitor job performance, validate data quality, and receive alerts when something fails
